notes: Text read 2026-10-18 and rechecked 2026-10-19. One public document holds both rulebooks; the agent rules sit mainly in the Visa Product and Service Rules, section 4.1.24, Agentic Platform Requirements (ID# 0031167 to 0031177, pages 254 to 260). 1.1.1.5 (ID# 0007428): the rules govern the relationship between Visa and its Members and their agents and confer no rights on third parties. 1.1.1.3 (ID# 0000385): where the rules conflict with applicable laws or regulations, the laws govern. 4.1.24.2 (ID# 0031168): an Agentic Payment Provider must enroll in and comply with the Visa Intelligent Commerce program and register with Visa, directly or via an Agentic Payment Enabler; obtain a Token from Visa or an Agentic Payment Enabler when it uses a Stored Credential; and not undertake an Agentic Transaction in a Card-Present Environment or aggregate several Agentic Transactions into one. 4.1.24.10 (ID# 0031176): a Cardholder is responsible for any actions an Agentic Payment Provider takes as part of an Agentic Transaction as if the Cardholder initiated the Transaction. Glossary, Cardholder (ID# 0024372): an Agentic Payment Provider is considered the Cardholder for an Agentic Transaction. Glossary, Agentic Payment Provider (ID# 0031164): the provider of an application a Cardholder uses for tasks on the Cardholder's behalf, which can search, discover and purchase on a payment instruction and Cardholder verification, can undertake an Agentic Transaction, can be used at more than one Merchant, stores and transmits a Token (an EMV payment token, ID# 0029108), completes a Transaction by passing the Token to the Merchant, and takes no part in authorization, clearing or settlement. 1.7.6.1 (ID# 0006558): an Issuer must pay the Acquirer for an Agentic Transaction processed in accordance with a Cardholder's payment instructions. 1.7.4.1 (ID# 0029326): an Issuer must not block or decline transactions, including those of Agentic Payment Providers, in a systematic or wholesale manner, with listed exceptions (an immediate fraud threat, law, the rules; a footnote excludes Chile). 5.4.2.5 (ID# 0008771): a Merchant must not require a Cardholder to waive the right to dispute a Transaction, including an Agentic Transaction. 1.5.5.2 (ID# 0006948): a Merchant, Agentic Payment Enabler or Agentic Payment Provider must not surcharge, with regional exceptions. Dispute Condition 10.4, invalid disputes (ID# 0030254): for disputes processed on or after 2026-10-24, the matching data from earlier undisputed transactions includes login IDs for an Agentic Payment Provider. The archived copy (captured 2025-11-24) is the 2025-10-18 edition, which lists these rules under 'Global Agentic Payments/Visa Intelligent Commerce (VIC) Program Launched', effective 2025-10-18 (2025-11-04 in Chile).
